Since de77ecd4ef02 (""bonding: improve link-status update in
mii-monitoring"")
column2: the bonding driver has utilized two separate variables

column1: to indicate the next link state a particular slave should transition to.
Each is used to communicate to a different portion of the link state
change commit logic; one to the bond_miimon_commit function itself
another to the state transition logic.
Unfortunately
column2: the two variables can become unsynchronized

column1: resulting in incorrect link state transitions within bonding.  This can
cause slaves to become stuck in an incorrect link state until a
subsequent carrier state transition.
The issue occurs when a special case in bond_slave_netdev_event
sets slave->link directly to BOND_LINK_FAIL.  On the next pass through
bond_miimon_inspect after the slave goes carrier up
case will set the proposed next state (link_new_state) to BOND_LINK_UP
but the new_link to BOND_LINK_DOWN.  The setting of the final link state
from new_link comes after that from link_new_state
will end up incorrectly in _DOWN state.
Resolve this by combining the two variables into one.
